  - `gov accept`'s runner drops every `PYTHON*` variable from the child's environment. The heavy slot's `python3` also needs `PYTHONUSERBASE=/home/usain/.local` when `HOME` is overridden.
  - `gov links` treats a change as marked when the changed entry's status line names the changer anywhere. So a prose id on the status line itself is never reported as UNMARKED_CHANGE, today or after the fix. S11's effect only shows for ids on sub-items or on a label's own line (README S11-P1).
